precepts.text: Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again. So that is what he meant when he said in three days I will rebuild this temple.
precepts.point: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up. Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?
precepts.why:
After the crucifixion the chief priests and Pharisees came to Pilate, “Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.”

They called him a deceiver, but they remembered exactly what he said, and they understood it: after three days I will rise again. That was what he meant when he said in three days I will rebuild this temple.

They had heard him teach it. So when they put up false witnesses saying he would destroy the temple and build it back, they were lying on him, twisting his words about the building, while among themselves they knew he spoke of rising from the dead. The temple raised up in three days is his body raised the third day.

precepts.text: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.
precepts.point: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him. It was written all over their face, all over their spirit. They could not hide it. Even a heathen would see that. And do we see that today? Yes. You have heathens making videos where they'll sit down with other heathens and say, okay, this camp believes in this, this camp believes in that. This camp is worldwide; they are an organized movement, they're global, they're not domestic. And this camp right here with the studs on, looking like the Legion of Doom from WWF, these guys over here hate these men in purple. Even the heathens know it. That is a damn shame.

note.label: The Inevitability of Obsolescence & Agony of Defeat

precepts.why:
Matthew says Pilate “knew that for envy they had delivered him”, and Mark says it plainly: “For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.” Pilate was a heathen, and even he could see it. It was written all over their face, all over their spirit. They could not hide it.

Do we see that today? Yes. You have heathens making videos where they sit down with other heathens and say, this camp believes in this, this camp believes in that. This camp is worldwide; they are an organized movement, global, not domestic. And this camp right here with the studs on, looking like the Legion of Doom from WWF, these guys over here hate these men in purple.

Even the heathens know it. That is a damn shame. The envy that delivered Christ is the same envy the heathen can see today.

precepts.text: They led him away to crucify him, and came unto a place called Golgotha; led away is the same as carried without the camp.
precepts.point: Hebrews draws the lesson: let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach. Put away the sacrifice as it was carried outside the temple, and come out unto Christ.

note.label: Leviticus 6: The Trespass Offering and the Fire That Shall Never Go Out

precepts.why:
The ashes of the burnt offering were carried forth without the camp unto a clean place, and Christ fulfilled that figure: “after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him.”

“And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull”, there they crucified him, outside the city. Led away is the same as carried without the camp: the sacrifice was taken outside, and so was he.

precepts.text: The veil of the temple was rent in twain when Christ died.
precepts.point: When Christ died the veil of the temple was rent and the priesthood was changed; the high priest now is Christ, for it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda. The sons of Levi no longer carry that office; Judah carries this work to the kingdom.

note.label: Leviticus 21: The Holiness of the Priests, the Sons of Aaron

precepts.why:
The high priest, “upon whose head the anointing oil was poured”, could not go out of the sanctuary, “for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him.” Under the old covenant his head was covered with the mitre.

When Christ died, “behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent.” The rending of the veil marks the change: the priesthood of Aaron’s sons and their sanctuary gave way, and the high priest now is Christ.

precepts.text: From the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land, and about the ninth hour Jesus cried, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani, that is, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me; this was fulfilled on the cross.
precepts.point: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? Why art thou so far from helping me? This is what Christ said when he was on the cross; Christ did not come to do away with the law but to fulfil it.

note.label: Psalm 22: The Prophecy of Christ on the Cross

precepts.why:
Here is the fulfilment: “Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour. And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?”

Darkness over all the land from the sixth hour to the ninth, and then Christ cried the very words of Psalm 22:1. This was fulfilled on the cross. What David wrote in the psalms concerning him, Christ fulfilled, because he came not to do away with the law but to fulfil it.

precepts.text: A notable prisoner named Barabbas was set beside Jesus, who was delivered up and bound.
precepts.point: Every man of the Most High went to prison, from Jeremiah, John, and Christ himself to Paul and Silas, as every man who fought oppression was jailed; the teacher who pushes prophecy is counted the same threat.

note.label: Acts 5: All Things Common, and We Ought to Obey God Rather Than Men

precepts.why:
“And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.” Barabbas was set beside Jesus, who was delivered up and bound. Christ himself was in the hands of the authorities as a prisoner.

Every man who fought oppression was jailed, and a man who pushes prophecy is counted the same threat. Prepare for it: set aside a nest so your wife and family are provided for if you are locked up, for they will freeze accounts and take houses. The Most High will help, as he sent the angel to open the prison doors, but you must still prepare.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 8 A Star Called Wormwood

precepts.why: Notice what our forefathers said about Christ. “Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.” See what the Israelites said. These are the wicked spirits, men and women who hated Christ, and these are the same ones that followed Christ, and Christ said to them, you don't follow me because of the miracles I do, you follow me because you were filled with the bread; you only follow me so you can get filled with food. Those same spirits betrayed Christ; they are the same ones saying crucify him. This is why we got jacked up as a people, and our children will die here in America that follow the evil.

They spit on him and smote him on the head, and after they had mocked him, they led him away to crucify him. We wear purple to commemorate Christ being mocked, because in the end he gets the glory; he gets the last laugh.

The point is Christ being mocked. You have Israelites saying this movement is a joke and cannot be taken seriously because comedians did skits making fun of us.
